target.description: Stimulus-pair decoding across source region pairs, relevance conditions and onset/offset periods; supplementary relevance and cross-task analyses remain distinct. This is not consciousness detection.

dataset.description: COGITATE-derived regional MEG data. Resolve registered Zenodo v1 against author v2 and corrected publication before fixing immutable empirical inputs.

cohort.description: Original analysis uses all 94 participants. An arbitrary smaller roster is not a same-task comparison.

split.description: Original stimulus/relevance analysis uses ten stratified participant-group folds; pinned code shuffles with random_state=127. Exact input ordering and realized membership must be reconstructed. Prospective nested folds are not interchangeable.

inputs.description: Source FC values derive from regional time series averaged by participant and event type. Preserve this condition-averaged input task and its exposure; do not relabel it as single-trial unknown-category prediction.

preprocessing.description: The source z-scores and detrends time series, screens 262 FC measures to 246, then uses the pinned feature-quality and mixed-sigmoid classifier pipeline. Changing screening or train-only scaling must be declared as a method change, with identical evaluation support.

metric.description: Accuracy at probability threshold 0.5: correct held-out predictions divided by held-out observations in each source fold. AUC and balanced accuracy are not replacement primary scores.

aggregation.description: Arithmetic mean and SD across the ten test folds for each source endpoint; region pairs, relevance and stimulus periods stay separately identified. No prospective equal-person aggregation substitution.

full_panel.description: Retain the full original per-participant connectivity output and post-QC 246-measure family across six directed ROI pairs, two relevance settings, two periods and six stimulus pairs: 144 endpoint combinations per eligible measure, with the original block-specific exclusions. Retain ten-fold accuracy and population SD, source AUC companions, original permutation/surrogate and connectivity controls, and separately identified relevance-decoding and cross-relevance analyses. Source-linked barycenter/robustness/model companion panels and historical nuisance/source-leakage controls require exact publication-to-output scope reconciliation. The four named Fig. 3b/3c inherited scalar claims below are neither independently authenticated targets nor a complete panel. Exact measure/cell identities and all required companion numeric outputs remain unresolved; no scalar or categorical surrogate stands in for their arrays.

permitted_observations.description: Original classifier inputs are regional functional-connectivity values computed after averaging by participant and known stimulus/event condition, including source relevance and onset/offset labels. Original participant-group folds control stimulus-decoding evaluation; the cross-relevance companion instead trains/tests relevance domains in the same participant cohort. These exposures are not single-trial unknown-category or consciousness-detection inputs. Paired paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions must share the exact original scientific inputs and expose author code only in the second condition; authentic delivery and exposure manifests remain unbound.

blocking_issues: The four inherited Fig. 3b/3c numerical claims are not independently authenticated targets or a full computational reproduction contract. All expected values remain null. The full measure-by-endpoint arrays cannot be encoded as a scalar surrogate; exact 246-measure IDs, eligibility and all original scalar-cell targets must first be authenticated and enumerated.

The sole authorized exact primary article open at PMC13338905 returned a three-line browser/reCAPTCHA challenge. Existing improvement.v1.json reports 0.670/0.083 and 0.643/0.094, but its prior verified label and the classifier code do not independently authenticate those printed source values. Preserve this primary reread gap; do not infer targets from code or retry the challenged route in this rollout.

Resolve canonical Zenodo v1 data.zip against article-linked v2 empirical.zip and bind the corrected supplement to an exact publisher-authenticated held version. Metadata, URLs and existing code pins do not establish empirical identity.

The public 94-ID list does not authenticate the empirical cohort/alias/row join. Freeze complete original observations, ordering, masks, source regions, preprocessing, block QC and realized ten participant folds; do not substitute prospective nested folds.

The original-fold-score API starts from supplied operator labels, folds and probabilities. It does not derive regional time series, connectivity features, fitted parameters or authentic model predictions; read_author_matrix imports summaries and cannot distinguish calculation from copied published aggregates.

Original permutation/surrogate/significance companions need exact tested contrasts, shuffle/exchangeability unit, null realizations, multiplicity and numerical targets. No test threshold, resampling count or significance target is inferred from absent source evidence.

Complete original connectivity/barycenter, polarity/aggregation robustness and source-linked model companions require exact scope, per-observation/per-parameter outputs and numerical source targets. Historical nuisance/Spearman/source-mixing requirements must remain explicit without being mislabeled as authenticated published findings.

Supplementary relevance-decoding and cross-relevance transfer outputs remain distinct from primary stimulus decoding. Their full measure/support identities, source-native predictions and targets are not handled by the accepted primary scorer or frozen here.
Justified numerical reproduction tolerances and uncertainty rules are unresolved. Printed precision and descriptive fold SD do not define an equivalence margin or independent confidence interval.

No authentic-data manifest, complete analysis interface, independent granular-output verification program or common paired-condition exposure/resource protocol is frozen. Omit admission_policy rather than manufacture identity hashes; both outcome pairing protocols remain unresolved.
